detections.source: NASA FIRMS (MODIS, VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20)
detections.note: Raw detections exist only where the sensor observed. Months where the requested scale is estimated (e.g. VIIRS-eq before 2012) have no raw points: use kind=cells to get their counts per cell. Points are selected by their own location, cells by their center, so totals can differ slightly at the area edge; the series counts S-NPP only as viirs_reported, while raw VIIRS rows include NOAA-20.
